Alcohol makes you sleepy because ` [Highlight start] it acts as a central nervous system depressant that slows brain activity and triggers calming brain chemicals [Highlight end] `.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xXK1YXfg3-itlOtfEMf3tO_KiM-5gAdHjxscgtrwlYULdpxA4zprwGc6KlU0TzJZQ2VoFrZWpiP-EzLd_p5ZSoZFK7dw99Tsd8LYCq71tJkmulzEXsuiem_Y450B2FWan65QVDS0vhZny-MWoK8Jk6I1fM860DQvg-PTFM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX2KfSskdjNKr30ffzAYZH8sKnU14hMye_hixoEkxib-uouWtnybnILyxrfVHYmlVvkD2UEmcUotFFsgWV1VNxAnddPTVYDr42zADdJObb4apQ1TTfCvcRlsJQ4RhvUgohKdzAT5OjFdmHeL3NSPHyFVmY)

### Why It Causes Drowsiness

- **Slows brain activity:** Ethanol slows the central nervous system, reducing alertness and reaction speed.
- **Boosts GABA:** It increases gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), a neurotransmitter that calms the brain and promotes relaxation.
- **Lowers glutamate:** It suppresses glutamate, an excitatory chemical that normally keeps you awake and focused.
- **Amplifies existing fatigue:** Drinking on an empty stomach, drinking quickly, or already being tired or slightly sleep-deprived can make the drowsy effect hit harder.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXX2KfSskdjNKr30ffzAYZH8sKnU14hMye_hixoEkxib-uouWtnybnILyxrfVHYmlVvkD2UEmcUotFFsgWV1VNxAnddPTVYDr42zADdJObb4apQ1TTfCvcRlsJQ4RhvUgohKdzAT5OjFdmHeL3NSPHyFVmY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xXK1YXfg3-itlOtfEMf3tO_KiM-5gAdHjxscgtrwlYULdpxA4zprwGc6KlU0TzJZQ2VoFrZWpiP-EzLd_p5ZSoZFK7dw99Tsd8LYCq71tJkmulzEXsuiem_Y450B2FWan65QVDS0vhZny-MWoK8Jk6I1fM860DQvg-PTFM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXpwfx_JfjBgBPQzNf6PRNfC_xCKSy7ZHb7NvAViaiK3yXuxIROiHe_DFX1V4slS00HFOjCbVJNFu0sE884EhfL5WsmkYJuUP243n47VyOq-qroUeCQoGb6d60PxOeX3oSE289n7kZj88XYYmCLGWVFKwFWQcysg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXVlJDbgCffABOyj0g3p3FTzn4bv7VwA2V58c115fJvpbHz-s51ZPu0zY0ftsKcr2rE5wLwK5y9IvcWoq0PbCVw_-iBaLaaSZnhf4iCCd-BJzcf15B8TEU62Da20spLgjSadZmr7AC85NFYRDFffigFNB8uuMa)

### What Happens Later

Even though a drink can help you drift off faster, it often disrupts sleep quality later on. As your body metabolizes the alcohol—usually a few hours later—it can suppress REM sleep, relax throat muscles, increase nighttime bathroom trips, and cause rebound wakefulness. [Verywell Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xXK1YXfg3-itlOtfEMf3tO_KiM-5gAdHjxscgtrwlYULdpxA4zprwGc6KlU0TzJZQ2VoFrZWpiP-EzLd_p5ZSoZFK7dw99Tsd8LYCq71tJkmulzEXsuiem_Y450B2FWan65QVDS0vhZny-MWoK8Jk6I1fM860DQvg-PTFM) explains how these brain chemical shifts and sleep stage changes work, while [Harvard Health](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXVlJDbgCffABOyj0g3p3FTzn4bv7VwA2V58c115fJvpbHz-s51ZPu0zY0ftsKcr2rE5wLwK5y9IvcWoq0PbCVw_-iBaLaaSZnhf4iCCd-BJzcf15B8TEU62Da20spLgjSadZmr7AC85NFYRDFffigFNB8uuMa) covers how alcohol's sedative and rebound effects lead to fatigue and nighttime awakenings. [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF17lxiTuEHbVNF3zFMIvt0K9SaoX6RuvjxhZASiSkEEemjoUlIyzBmoTcE2HO_fVrRm-sYvGW7D3CLO7563UOqjsSWEsYqXr9kePzb1zH4PxS_ZUgXQZbFHHxszJGe1LYLdgJ4jPmhBwuG1h77hsb4Aw96QDSauA-loivkb8) also notes why alcohol isn't a reliable sleep aid and highlights practical tips for sleeping after drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF17lxiTuEHbVNF3zFMIvt0K9SaoX6RuvjxhZASiSkEEemjoUlIyzBmoTcE2HO_fVrRm-sYvGW7D3CLO7563UOqjsSWEsYqXr9kePzb1zH4PxS_ZUgXQZbFHHxszJGe1LYLdgJ4jPmhBwuG1h77hsb4Aw96QDSauA-loivkb8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xXK1YXfg3-itlOtfEMf3tO_KiM-5gAdHjxscgtrwlYULdpxA4zprwGc6KlU0TzJZQ2VoFrZWpiP-EzLd_p5ZSoZFK7dw99Tsd8LYCq71tJkmulzEXsuiem_Y450B2FWan65QVDS0vhZny-MWoK8Jk6I1fM860DQvg-PTFM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF11Nr_qkoNalo1wJf7Oo2itlN5aC34k23kPQcMeL-QYilUWO33q4jZwOPhdCmAdVs4xjrClySUB-9rqaC3GoZU5EvSqjZp0Ybo0pGfETB983pi9MzoN1RWdpLEA3rzYratjWfQBcqScd7597vKBI0HaKaDX2JcCcVgDnZ9Er46XRI8onPZfr_KAAVTjIa7Ek)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXVlJDbgCffABOyj0g3p3FTzn4bv7VwA2V58c115fJvpbHz-s51ZPu0zY0ftsKcr2rE5wLwK5y9IvcWoq0PbCVw_-iBaLaaSZnhf4iCCd-BJzcf15B8TEU62Da20spLgjSadZmr7AC85NFYRDFffigFNB8uuMa)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXX6q81EityWiCbdAPBZbY9OFP0vvD5aBIwJRHm-VjOpZlkIzqpLPru_DBCY-kc-HaKrjYVEfZfaQsnk383Vg0tFUrfNKAkeqGQk6vHvhWkFASgcqVyha25B0NXkRK_EmeeJGx3RdFHKsmgo3oRPB-oxke7FTI)Are you asking because you get **sleepy right after a drink** , or because you **wake up tired** the next day?
